{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# 1. Convert revenue from string to float: remove commas and cast
# Check for the internal test orders (revenue = 999999.99)
print("Rows with revenue = 999999.99:")
print(df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99'])

# Remove internal test orders
filtered_df = df[df['revenue'] != '999999.99']

# Convert revenue to float after removing commas
filtered_df['revenue'] = filtered_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders
completed_orders = filtered_df[filtered_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Calculate total revenue from completed orders
total_revenue = completed_orders['revenue'].sum()

print(f"Total revenue from completed orders (excluding internal test orders): {total_revenue}")"}
